metadata.description: Agent skills organised by domain — deeply researched, provenance-tracked, and kept current against fast-moving ecosystems

plugins.name: generative-media-skills
plugins.description: Pick a generative-media model, then run it well. A cross-suite atlas ranks image and video models by job and settles model choice with a licence-first elimination ladder, then routes the goal through the skills it needs — alongside authoritative ComfyUI, diffusers and API guides for each model: image (FLUX.2, Ideogram 4, Z-Image, Qwen-Image, SDXL, Krea 2, Anima) and video (Wan 2.2, MiniMax H3, LTX-2.5, SCAIL-2) — spanning setup, prompting across tag and natural-language conditioning classes, ControlNet and motion/camera control, native audio-video generation, multishot single-generation cuts, face identity, character consistency across frames and shots, in-video character replacement, LoRA training and evaluation, the image-to-video handoff, licence and territory pitfalls, multi-stage and mixed-model production pipelines, GPU deployment on RunPod, and failure modes

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Build software with AI agents in Claude Code, Codex or another host. A planner writes milestones with JSON done-when files and dependencies between modules, builders prove them, and fresh reviewers judge them. /build keeps a chosen number of builders busy on ready milestones and rejects claims it can't verify.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Creates, rewrites and tests agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and other agents, in plain explanatory prose. Follows Anthropic's skill-creator process, with isolated baselines, repeated runs, trigger tests and a structural check script.

plugins.name: instructing-agents
plugins.description: Writes and checks the text one agent hands another: Agent or Task prompts, codex exec and claude -p prompts, goals, steers, review requests and AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, for Claude Code and Codex. Carries what the agent can't find out itself (purpose, done, boundaries, where things are) and leaves out the method and what to look at.
